items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: They had one they called Catherine.

ctx.x: Well, where did you see the real Indians in those days?

At my grandmother's. When I was a child, she always had Indians that would come from Bafouca and I don't know where across the lake there. And she, when they'd come, they used to be at that market they called Lahal Sovar, Indian market. It's Bayou Road on the other side of the road. No, on this side of the road. And when they was too far from my grandmother, they'd sleep in the, in the yard inside the, what's the name? But when they was closer to my, my grandmother's place, they would come home. Sometimes there'd…
Have you ever heard any songs about slavery? Songs of slaves or songs about wanting to be free?
